T1-NFKC|description|'Slide rule with case and instructions, Crompton-Gallagher Boiler Efficiency, closed frame, wood / celluloid / cardboard / paper, made by Gallagher and Crompton Manchester, England, 1919 Slide rule, Crompton-Gallagher Boiler Efficiency, special construction, wood, closed frame, dual slides plus transverse sliding chart, single-sided. Wood, celluloid scale faces, in cloth covered card case with stencil printed instructions on Gallagher and Crompton letterhead, Manchester, UK, 1919 Crompton and Gallagher Boiler Efficiency Calculator. Crompton-Gallagher Patent No.128,878/1919 Scales: Stock, upper: (D) Calorific Value of Fuel, British Thermal Units (for low grade fuel, coal, Tar oil, Oils); Pounds of Water Evaporated per Lb. of Fuel Slide, upper stock: (Slide C) Factors of Evaporation, Efficiency %, Pounds of Water Evaporated … Stock, upper mid: (E) Lbs of Water Evaporated per Lb of Fuel Slide, lower: (Slide A) Temperature of Feed Water Stock, lower: (B) Factors of Evaporation. Corrected for Super Heat Transverse slide chart: Nomographs of Superheat Curves for Boiler Pressure and Temperature of Saturated Steam. Three values are needed to use the calculator; the observed Boiler Pressure, the observed Temperature of the Feed-water and the observed degree of superheat. The transverse chart is slid against the bevelled edge of the slide A until it stands at the line that represents the boiler pressure. Slide A is then slid across the chart until the observed feedwater temperature matches the point where the nomograph curve of the degree of superheat intersects the boiler pressure line. The gauge pointer of slide A will then point to the Evaporation Factor on scale B.'|'Slide rule with case and instructions, Crompton-Gallagher Boiler Efficiency, closed frame, wood / celluloid / cardboard / paper, made by Gallagher and Crompton Manchester, England, 1919 Slide rule, Crompton-Gallagher Boiler Efficiency, special construction, wood, closed frame, dual slides plus transverse sliding chart, single-sided. Wood, celluloid scale faces, in cloth covered card case with stencil printed instructions on Gallagher and Crompton letterhead, Manchester, UK, 1919 Crompton and Gallagher Boiler Efficiency Calculator. Crompton-Gallagher Patent No.128,878/1919 Scales: Stock, upper: (D) Calorific Value of Fuel, British Thermal Units (for low grade fuel, coal, Tar oil, Oils); Pounds of Water Evaporated per Lb. of Fuel Slide, upper stock: (Slide C) Factors of Evaporation, Efficiency %, Pounds of Water Evaporated ... Stock, upper mid: (E) Lbs of Water Evaporated per Lb of Fuel Slide, lower: (Slide A) Temperature of Feed Water Stock, lower: (B) Factors of Evaporation. Corrected for Super Heat Transverse slide chart: Nomographs of Superheat Curves for Boiler Pressure and Temperature of Saturated Steam. Three values are needed to use the calculator; the observed Boiler Pressure, the observed Temperature of the Feed-water and the observed degree of superheat. The transverse chart is slid against the bevelled edge of the slide A until it stands at the line that represents the boiler pressure. Slide A is then slid across the chart until the observed feedwater temperature matches the point where the nomograph curve of the degree of superheat intersects the boiler pressure line. The gauge pointer of slide A will then point to the Evaporation Factor on scale B.'
